parameters.name: IpSegment
parameters.description: The list of IP ranges. Use a hyphen (-) to separate the start and end IP addresses. Specify one IP segment per line. You can specify 1 to 50 IP ranges. To specify a single IP address, use the format IP1-IP1. The IP ranges cannot overlap.

sub_parameters.name: EndIp
sub_parameters.description: The end IP address of the IP range.

sub_parameters.name: StartIp
sub_parameters.description: The start IP address of the IP range.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese

- **en**: English

parameters.name: LineId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the custom line. You can call [DescribeCustomLines](~~2355671~~) to obtain this ID.

parameters.name: LineName
parameters.description: The name of the custom line. The name must be 1 to 20 characters long and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_).
